expressions.situation: Thank someone who has helped you or handed you something.
expressions.pronunciationNote: Capital letters mark the emphasized practice syllable, not English-style lexical stress. Keep the French r gentle at the back of the throat.
One short syllable: move directly from w to ee. Capital letters are a practice cue, not a direction to shout.

expressions.situation: Answer a simple question negatively; add merci when politely declining.
expressions.pronunciationNote: The ending n marks a nasal vowel: do not pronounce a separate final n. Keep one pure vowel, without an English oh glide.
